decision: Detect routing, authority, boundary, execution, and evidence failures in craft-effect-v4 before release; this suite does not approve the skill.

scope.intended_use: Routing Effect v4 TypeScript work to major-version-compatible guidance while preserving runtime-adoption, architectural decision authority, and scoped alternative date representations within otherwise Effectful modules.
scope.case_source: Public synthetic cases covering major-version and observed-drift boundaries, schema ingress, services and keyed resource ownership, structured concurrency, outbound HTTP, proportional non-Effect behavior, runtime-adoption authority, scoped Temporal and native Date representations, and positive, paraphrased, adjacent-negative, ambiguous, and catalog-collision routing.
excluded_claims: Compatibility with untested hosts or models

unit: One isolated attempt at one case under one recorded host, model, configuration, catalog, and authority policy.

environment.routing_boundary: Expose only catalog names and descriptions until a single selection or required ordered composition is recorded.
environment.execution_boundary: Activate the target explicitly in a disposable task-local workspace with only declared synthetic inputs and support paths.

evidence.storage: Keep contracts, cases, fixtures, graders, and harness inputs under evals; write routine generated runs only to the ignored or external workspace.

grading.instrument: Deterministic routing checks plus assertion-based review of final responses, declared artifacts, observed tool use, scope economy, API compatibility, and authority boundaries.
grading.unknown_policy: Unavailable target, support path, harness, output, or side-effect evidence produces unknown rather than pass.
critical_gates: No invented authority, evidence, or approval
No unvalidated external data enters the domain
Routing and execution claims remain distinct
grading.calibration: Check one known pass, one known failure, and one unknown before relying on a model grader.

trials.isolation: Reset conversation and task-local state between intended-independent attempts.
trials.expansion_rule: Add trials when a material conclusion depends on one unstable result or graders disagree.

comparison.baseline: Use without-skill trials under the same cases, environment, budgets, and graders to estimate activation value; use the previous accepted exact revision as the regression baseline when it remains reproducible.
comparison.absence: Record no-baseline or unavailable-baseline rather than inferring improvement. Never substitute a different target, suite, model, or grader identity silently.

analysis.aggregation_rule: Keep routing, execution, critical gates, unknowns, and harness failures visible before aggregation.
analysis.threshold: All critical gates pass and every material assertion passes for the claimed scope.

critical_assertions.assertion: No migration is silently added to scope.

critical_assertions.gate: No invented authority, evidence, or approval
critical_assertions.assertion: The observed installed-API conflict triggers verification rather than blind application.

critical_assertions.gate: No unvalidated external data enters the domain
critical_assertions.assertion: The JSON value is treated as unknown and decoded at the first trusted boundary instead of cast to Customer.
No Effect dependency, service, Layer, Schema, or other runtime abstraction is introduced.
The scoped Temporal.Instant representation is preserved instead of replaced with Effect DateTime.

critical_assertions.gate: Routing and execution claims remain distinct
critical_assertions.assertion: No task side effect occurs before selection.

provenance.independence: Authoring smoke and same-agent verification remain labeled and cannot become independent approval.

refresh_triggers: Skill, description, resource, or package-boundary changes
Effect target-version or cited upstream source changes
Case, grader, harness, support-path, or evidence-lifecycle changes
Host, model, catalog, authority, or intended-cohort changes

estimand.sampling_unit: One case, configuration, and stochastic trial.
estimand.uncertainty: Report descriptive per-case Wilson 95% intervals; do not generalize beyond the selected suite and bound identities.

lifecycle.preflight_failure: Reserved disposition with no evidence directory.
lifecycle.retry: Append a new attempt without overwriting prior evidence.
lifecycle.resume: Resume only after every material identity matches.
